content:
We need to propose a retrosynthesis route for target: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Structure: a tolyl sulfonamide attached to a phenyl ring bearing a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (para-aminobenzamide). So overall three fragments: tolyl sulfonyl chloride? Actually sulfonamide linking two aryl groups: tolyl amine (p-methyl aniline) attached to sulfonyl group attached to second phenyl bearing the unsaturated amide side chain.

Goal: <=3 steps, leaves commercially available, total cost <$9999.

We need to find retrosynthetic disconnections: 1) formation of sulfonamide bond between tolyl amine and sulfonyl chloride derived from second aryl sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonyl fluoride). So step: sulfonylation of p-toluidine with aryl sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride derived from 4-(... )-phenylsulfonyl chloride). That sulfonyl chloride can be made from sulfonylation of the second phenyl with SO2Cl2? Actually aryl sulfonyl chloride can be purchased (e.g., 4-(... )-phenylsulfonyl chloride). Might be commercially available.

Second disconnection: the unsaturated amide side chain can be formed via Heck coupling (C=C) then amidation? Actually the side chain is /C=C/C(=O)N- aniline. Could be formed by condensation of cinnamic acid derivative with aniline (amide formation). So we could have precursor: 4-(cinnamoylamino)aniline (i.e., aniline with amide attached to cinnamic acid). That could be made by coupling aniline with trans-cinnamic acid (or its activated derivative). So step: amide formation between aniline (the second phenyl's para amino) and trans-cinnamic acid (or its acid chloride). So we need aniline with para amino (the same phenyl) that also has sulfonyl attached at para? Wait the second phenyl has both sulfonyl attachment (via sulfonamide) at para? Actually the target: NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2. So the sulfonamide attaches to the phenyl at position 1 (connected to sulfonyl). The phenyl also has a para substituent: /C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N (i.e., trans-cinnamoyl anilide). So the phenyl is disubstituted: sulfonamide at one position, and the unsaturated amide at para.

Thus we could retrosynthesize by first forming the sulfonamide after having the phenyl with the unsaturated amide already installed. So step 1: sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride) reacts with p-toluidine to give target.

Thus we need to get aryl sulfonyl chloride: 4-(cinnamoylamino)phenylsulfonyl chloride. That can be made from 4-(cinnamoylamino)benzenesulfonic acid (or its sulfonyl chloride). Could be prepared by chlorination of the sulfonic acid (SO3H) using SOCl2. Starting from 4-(cinnamoylamino)benzenesulfonic acid (commercial?). Might be not.

Alternative: first form the sulfonamide using sulfonyl chloride derived from 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride then do Suzuki coupling to install the cinnamoyl anilide? But the unsaturated amide is attached via C=C to carbonyl then aniline. Could be formed via Heck coupling of aryl bromide with acrylamide? Actually we could have aryl bromide (para-bromo phenyl) attached to sulfonamide, then perform Heck coupling with acrylamide (CH2=CH-CO-NH-Ph). That would give the trans-α,β-unsaturated amide directly. So route: 1) sulfonamide formation between p-toluidine and 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride (commercial). 2) Heck coupling of the resulting aryl bromide (para-bromo) with acrylamide (or N-phenylacrylamide). But the amide side chain is C=CC(=O)Nc3ccccc3N (i.e., trans-cinnamoyl anilide). That's an acrylamide where the amide nitrogen is attached to an aniline (c3ccccc3N). So the coupling partner could be N-phenylacrylamide (i.e., CH2=CH-CO-NH-Ph). That is commercially available? Possibly. So step 2: Heck coupling of aryl bromide with N-phenylacrylamide to give the trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to phenyl.

Thus total steps: 2 steps (sulfonamide formation, then Heck coupling). Leaves: p-toluidine, 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride, N-phenylacrylamide. All commercially available.

Check availability: p-toluidine (4-methylaniline) is cheap. 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride (p-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride) is commercial. N-phenylacrylamide (acrylamide with phenyl on N) is also commercial (N-phenylacrylamide). Need to verify buyable.

Let's check is_buyable for these three.
